failure.mechanism: The Official checkout was not trusted by Git under its runtime ownership. setuptools_scm invoked Git while preparing editable metadata and failed with detected dubious ownership before Pyright ran.
failure.repeated_failure_family: basxconnect and clarity independently fail because the submitted program does not normalize Git safe-directory state in the Official deployment environment.

deployment_completeness.reason: The candidate used --no-deps for the project and direct providers, so end-to-end runtime completeness was not established even though advisory missing-import verification passed.
